title: Homotopy morphisms into a termwise injective complex are exact
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Let $0\to A^\bullet\to B^\bullet\to C^\bullet\to0$ be a short exact sequence of cochain complexes (cochain complexes and their morphisms are as in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]) in $\mathcal A$, and let $I^\bullet$ be a cochain complex whose every term is injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Then the sequence of abelian groups $\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal A)}(C^\bullet,I^\bullet)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal A)}(B^\bullet,I^\bullet)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal A)}(A^\bullet,I^\bullet)$ is exact at the middle group.
